$description: Design tokens (DTCG). Source of truth for the CSS in this directory. Each token records its CSS custom property in $extensions.

border-width.$description: Line widths for border and outline. 1 is the default divider and input border, 2 a selected tab or emphasised edge, 3 a focus ring or accent stripe, 4 a heavy accent bar.

size.$description: Layout widths and sizes. container: the max-width of a page or panel's content column, from a card or truncated preview (xs) and a narrow form (sm) to a wide dashboard (xl); dialog: the one width of a dialog, popup or toast. column-min: the narrowest a card may get in an auto-fitting grid, as in minmax(var(--column-min-md), 1fr). tap-target: the smallest a control may be on a touch screen, 44px (2.75rem), as WCAG 2.5.5 asks. icon: the five sizes of an icon, avatar or badge, 16, 20, 24, 32 and 48px (xs to xl); a Lucide icon takes the same steps as numbers from ICON_SIZE in web/ui/icons.js. panel: the height of a chart, a scrolling list or a media frame, 160, 240 and 320px (sm to lg).

breakpoint.$description: Where a layout changes, as a @media width: phone below 640px, tablet or small laptop from 640 to 1024px, wide from 1280px. A @media query cannot read a custom property, so CSS writes these as numbers (min-width: 640px), and stylelint allows only these three; the properties are for scripts (matchMedia) and Figma.

opacity.$description: How faded something is (the designer's decision 10). disabled: a control that cannot be used now, or a locked step. muted: something done, past or secondary that is still read. An overlay behind a dialog is the scrim colour, not an opacity.

layer.$description: Stacking order (z-index). base: the page itself; raised: one element above its siblings inside a component (a badge on a card, a sticky table header over its rows); sticky: the app header, banners and sticky page bars; dropdown: menus, popovers and tooltips; overlay: dialogs, lightboxes and the scrim behind them; toast: notifications and the cookie notice, above everything. A component's own stacking stays inside it: a menu inside a dialog is above the dialog because the dialog is its stacking context.

glow.$description: The blur of a coloured glow, as in 0 0 var(--glow-md) var(--color-glow). Only the size: the colour is a role (glow, reward, brand, success) chosen where it is used.

edge-depth.$description: How far the solid 3D edge under a gamified button or card drops, as in 0 var(--edge-depth) 0 var(--color-edge).

shadow-dark.$description: Dark mode for the shadows sm to xl: the same geometry with stronger black, so raised surfaces still stand out on a dark background. Switched on by the skills app's toggle (:root[data-theme='dark']), as color-dark is; the stars app never sets it.

motion.$description: duration: fast for hover and focus tints, base for most state changes, moderate and slow for panels opening and things moving, slower for entrances, long for a progress fill or a celebration, loop for a repeating pulse, ambient for a slow repeating shimmer. ease: standard for most changes, out for things arriving, in for things leaving, in-out for a fill that starts and ends at rest, spring for a playful overshoot, linear for spinners and anything that repeats at a constant speed. Under prefers-reduced-motion, components remove or shorten their own animations.

display-fluid.$description: A display figure or hero title: 3xl up to 640px wide, growing to 4xl at 1280px and wider. Untyped: Figma cannot hold clamp().

h1-fluid.$description: A page title: 2xl up to 640px wide, growing to 3xl at 1280px and wider. Untyped: Figma cannot hold clamp().

text-style.$description: The eight text styles (the designer's decision 7), each a size, weight, line height and letter spacing. CSS gets one variable per property: --text-h2-size, --text-h2-weight, --text-h2-leading, --text-h2-tracking (and --text-caption-case). display and h1 grow with the window in CSS (fluidSize); Figma keeps their wide-screen size.

display.$description: A hero title or a big figure. Grows from 3xl on a phone to 4xl on a wide screen.

h1.$description: A page title, one per page. Grows from 2xl on a phone to 3xl on a wide screen.

label.$description: A form field label, a column heading, a button in a dense row.

caption.$description: An eyebrow above a heading, a timestamp, a tag. Upper case.
